text.en: This Order m ay be cited as the Misuse of Drugs (Amendment) Orderg 2010 · Amendment of section 29 of Chapter 27 ·

Section 29 of the Misuse of Drugs Act , in this Order referred to as the Act , is amended, in subsection ( 4 ) , by deleting "inmate" from the second last line and by substituting "resident" therefor. Amendment of section 33 ·
Section 33 of the Act is amended, in subsection (2B), by deleting "inmate" from the second line and from the fourth line and by substituting "resident" therefora Amendment of section 34 ·

Section 34 of the Act is amended, in subsection ( 1 ) c ) , by deleting "inmates" from the second line and from the third line and by substituting "residents" therefor. Made this 18th. day of safar, 1431 Hijriah corresponding to the 3rd. d ay of Februaryt 2010 at Our lstana Nurul lmanr Bandar Seri Begawan , Brunei Darussalam.

HIS MAJESTY

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM Dicetak oleh PENGIRAN HAJI ZAINAL ABIDIN BIN PENGIRAN SERI WIJAYA PENGIRAN HAJI AHMAD, Pemangku Pengarah Percetakan di Jabatan Percetakan Kerajaan, Bandar Seri Begawan BB3510 , Negara Brunei Darussalam. Harga B $ 5 · oo
